title: Release Surgeon: guided deploy composer and safety-check flow
creator: Lina Chen
description: Design and prototype a guided, stepwise composer for progressive releases (percent splits, cohort targeting, emergency rollback) that surfaces preflight checks and a compact safety checklist. The experience should enable engineers and PMs to perform controlled gradual deploys with clear signals, a dry-run simulation, and an immediate one-click rollback interface.
background: Current rollout UIs in the console are powerful but scattered across multiple pages. Teams frequently ask for a single guided composer that reduces cognitive load when wiring percent splits, adding safety gates, and preparing rollback runbooks. The 'Release Surgeon' concept centers on surgical precision in releases — conservative, observable, and reversible operations.
goals: Create an end-to-end guided composer that reduces time-to-launch for staged rollouts
Surface automated preflight checks and suggest safety gate defaults based on historical latency/error distributions
Provide a clear dry-run simulator and an audit-friendly summary before deploy
Make rollback discoverable and fast (single-click rollback with comparison view)
Ensure accessibility and clear microcopy to reduce operator error
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Kapoor (serving runtime), Harlan Beck (console infra)
user_journey: User opens "Release Surgeon" from model route -> selects variant(s) to release
Composer shows suggested default split (1%, 5%, 25%) + advanced targeting (region, customer tier)
Preflight step runs a dry-run simulation - returns expected latency and error delta with visual confidence bands
Safety gates step suggests thresholds (error rate, median latency, token cost delta) and auto-rollover behavior
Review step shows compact audit summary + preview of new routing map
Launch step triggers rollout and opens a live monitoring panel with quick rollback button
If metric breach occurs, operator can 'suture' (rollback) to previous variant and add notes to the audit trail
wireframe_notes: Main canvas: three-column layout: left = variant list + targeting, center = percent ramp timeline editor, right = safety panel + preflight results
Timeline editor: draggable anchors to set percentage at time checkpoints; allow keyboard entry for precision
Preflight panel: inline traffic shadowing toggle + quick estimate loader (approx 5-8s) with loading skeleton
Rollback CTA: prominent red 'Suture: Rollback' with confirmation that includes metric deltas since launch
Compact mode: condensed single-row composer for small-screen use or embedded flows in dedicated product pages
design_files: UI kit components used: rollout-timeline-v2, safety-gate-card, preflight-result-chart
decisions: Expose only three recommended ramp presets (conservative, balanced, aggressive) to reduce configuration error
Preflight simulation will run against a sampled traffic mirror and return probabilistic estimates rather than deterministic guarantees
Rollback will always create an immutable snapshot of route configuration and write an audit entry
Accessibility: timeline anchors must be keyboard-focusable and have 4.5:1 contrast for labels
acceptance_criteria: Designer-prototype reviewed and accepted by PM and Eng (design review confirmed in PRD comment)
Prototype demonstrates creating a 3-step rollout and performing a dry-run simulation
Timeline editor supports keyboard entry and drag handles in prototypes
Preflight panel shows sample size, expected median latency delta, and a warning if sample size < threshold
One-click rollback in the prototype opens a comparison diff and appends a note to the audit trail (simulated)
tasks: High-fidelity screens: main composer, condensed composer, live monitoring modal
Create copy guidelines and alert microcopy for safety gate triggers
Handoff tokens to Eng: component props and interaction spec
Run 2 design review sessions with PM and Engs; iterate on first-pass feedback
Produce usability script for a 5-person internal playtest
